about: The Workbench icons of the CrimsonFields drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art is the game's own 48x48 icon (gfx/crimson.png, GPL 2 with the game). CrimsonFields-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, CrimsonFields.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's CrimsonFields.info. ReadMe.info is also copied for ReadMe-crimson, COPYING.txt and Licences.txt; Data.info is the icon of every subdrawer (levels, locale, sound, music, User).
